description: Declarative caps for the Trading Rule Framework. Source of truth for `rules.gate.evaluate_trade_proposal` and `rules.adherence.compute_adherence`. Edit + reload — no migration. Calibration adjustments after 30 reviewed trades become the v2 PR per the success-metrics framework.

confluence_tiers.$comment: 0-8 score. Tier 0-4 = insufficient (no trade); 5-6 = standard sizing; 7-8 = high-conviction sizing eligible.

portfolio_level.$comment: max_trades_per_bucket=1 enforces the 'BTC+SOL+ETH = one trade' rule; max_bucket_exposure_pct=10% guards against a single bucket dominating the book even if max_trades_per_bucket=1 lets one big-size trade through.

severities.$comment: How each rule's violation is classified by the gate evaluator. 'hard' would block in enforce mode; 'soft' warns but allows; 'advisory' is FYI only. v1 advisory mode treats all the same (logs everything) but the classification is honored at the column on the wire so a future enforce-mode flip is one config change.
